COMPANY.TITLE: THE COMPANY
COMPANY.SUBTITLE: Leaders in automation engineering, IoT telemetry, SCADA systems, and process control in Water, Energy, and Oil & Gas.
COMPANY.STORY_DESC_1: ENERTRONIC INGENIERÍA S.A.C. is a Peruvian technological systems integration company founded in 2012. With more than 12 years of experience, it has evolved from industrial automation towards digital transformation and operational intelligence, integrating operational technologies (OT), information technologies (IT), and artificial intelligence (AI).
COMPANY.STORY_DESC_2: Under our comprehensive cycle (Capture, Connect, Visualize, Analyze, and Anticipate), we deploy field instrumentation, robust telemetry (satellite, cellular, and LoRaWAN), SCADA/IIoT platforms, and Machine Learning analytics. Our technical expertise is backed by critical projects executed for industry leaders such as Pluspetrol, Repsol, Electroperu, and SEDAPAL.
COMPANY.MISSION_TEXT: At ENERTRONIC INGENIERÍA S.A.C., our mission is to provide advanced and customized technological solutions that optimize our clients efficiency and sustainability. Through constant innovation, we seek to improve operational processes across various industries, guaranteeing reliable, safe, and high-performance results.
COMPANY.VISION_TEXT: We aspire to be the leading technological systems integration company in the Latin American market, recognized for our ability to deliver innovative, efficient, and sustainable solutions. We seek to contribute to the development and digital transformation of strategic economic sectors through a constant commitment to quality and technological advancement.
COMPANY.PILLAR_1_DESC: Development of real-time supervisory control systems with standard industrial protocols (Modbus, DNP3, IEC 104, MQTT).
COMPANY.PILLAR_2_DESC: Robust satellite, cellular, mesh radio, and wireless tunnel connectivity in remote sectors such as mining and energy.
COMPANY.PILLAR_3_DESC: Resilient architectures ensuring 24/7 operational availability and critical plant data protection.
